data.name: TrackerUrlMissing
data.value: The torrent has no tracker URL.
data.comment: Shown when a torrent cannot be announced.

data.name: TrackerUrlInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid tracker URL.
data.comment: {0} = the URL as typed.

data.name: TrackerUrlUnsupportedScheme
data.value: Only http and https trackers are supported; this one is {0}://. Pick another tracker from the torrent, if it has one.
data.comment: {0} = URL scheme such as udp.

data.name: TrackerNoResponse
data.value: The tracker did not respond within {0} seconds.
data.comment: {0} = number of seconds; always 60 in practice.

data.name: TrackerCertificateNotTrusted
data.value: The TLS certificate of {0} is not trusted: {1} Turn on "Ignore TLS certificate errors" in the torrent settings if you trust this tracker.
data.comment: {0} = host name, {1} = system error text. The quoted option must match the app's check box "Ignore TLS certificate errors on https trackers" (its start).

data.name: TrackerConnectFailed
data.value: Could not connect to {0}:{1} after {2} attempts.
data.comment: {0} = host, {1} = port, {2} = number of attempts; always 5 in practice.

data.name: TrackerAnnounceFailed
data.comment: {0} = tracker URL, {1} = reason.

data.name: TrackerScrapeFailed
data.comment: {0} = tracker URL, {1} = reason. A scrape is a tracker request for swarm statistics.

data.name: TrackerScrapeUnsupported
data.value: This tracker does not support scrape.

data.name: LogAnnouncingStarted
data.comment: Log line. "started" is the BitTorrent announce event.

data.name: LogAnnouncingCompleted
data.comment: Log line. "completed" is the BitTorrent announce event.

data.name: LogAnnouncingStopped
data.comment: Log line. "stopped" is the BitTorrent announce event.

data.name: LogAnnouncingUpdate
data.comment: Log line: a regular announce with no event.

data.name: LogUnexpectedError
data.comment: Log line. {0} = error text.

data.name: StopReasonUnexpectedError
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Error: ". Lower case in English because it continues a sentence.

data.name: LogNewTrackerKey
data.value: Generated a new tracker key, as the emulated client does.
data.comment: Log line. The key is the announce "key" parameter.

data.name: LogNoConnection
data.comment: Log line. {0} = error text.

data.name: LogWillRetry
data.comment: Log line. {0} = number of seconds; always 60 in practice.

data.name: LogTrackerError
data.comment: Log line and stop reason. {0} = the tracker's failure reason, in the tracker's language.

data.name: LogTrackerWarning
data.comment: Log line. {0} = the tracker's warning message, in the tracker's language. Unlike an error, a warning does not stop the torrent.

data.name: LogPeers
data.comment: Log line. {0} = number of peers the tracker returned, 1 or more.

data.name: LogScrapeError
data.comment: Log line. {0} = error text.

data.name: LogUploadPausedNoLeechers
data.value: The tracker reports no leechers; upload paused until it reports some.
data.comment: Log line.

data.name: LogUploadResumed
data.comment: Log line. {0} = one of the ResumeReason texts.

data.name: ResumeReasonLeechers
data.comment: Completes "Upload resumed: {0}." {0} = number of leechers, 1 or more (1 is common), so the text must be correct for 1 too.

data.name: ResumeReasonPauseSwitchedOff
data.value: the pause on no leechers was switched off
data.comment: Completes "Upload resumed: {0}."

data.name: StopReasonRanFor
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Stopped: ". {0} = the number of seconds the user chose, normally 60 or more.

data.name: StopReasonSeedersBelow
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Stopped: ".

data.name: StopReasonLeechersBelow
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Stopped: ".

data.name: StopReasonUploadedAbove
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Stopped: ". {0} = megabytes.

data.name: StopReasonDownloadedAbove
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Stopped: ". {0} = megabytes.

data.name: StopReasonRatioBelow
data.comment: Stop reason, shown after "Stopped: ". {0} = a ratio such as 1.5.

data.name: LogStopped
data.comment: Log line. {0} = stop reason.

data.name: LogStoppedAnnounceFailed
data.comment: Log line: the final "stopped" announce could not be sent. {0} = error text.

data.name: ListenerStartFailed
data.value: TCP listener could not start on port {0} (already in use?): {1}
data.comment: Log line. {0} = port number, {1} = error text.

data.name: ListenerStarted
data.comment: Log line. {0} = port number.

data.name: ListenerClosed
data.comment: Log line.

data.name: ScanLookingForProcess
data.comment: Log line while reading values from a running torrent client. {0} = process name.

data.name: ScanProcessNotFound
data.value: No {0} process found. Make sure the torrent client is running.
data.comment: {0} = process name.

data.name: ScanFailed
data.value: Search failed. Make sure {0} is running with at least one active torrent.
data.comment: {0} = client name such as uTorrent 3.6.0.

data.name: ScanSkippedAfterMiss
data.value: Not looking for the {0} process again yet: a search less than a minute ago found nothing.
data.comment: Log line when a torrent starts within a minute of a search of the running client that found nothing: the client is looked for at most once a minute. {0} = process name such as uTorrent.

data.name: TorrentCannotRead
data.comment: {0} = file path, {1} = error text.

data.name: TorrentInvalid
data.comment: {0} = a more specific error (one of the Bencode texts).

data.name: TorrentNoInfo
data.comment: "info" is a field name inside the .torrent file; keep it as is.

data.name: TorrentDamagedPieces
data.value: Missing or damaged piece hash codes.

data.name: TorrentNoFiles
data.value: The torrent has neither a file length nor a file list.

data.name: TorrentInvalidFileEntry
data.value: Invalid entry in the file list.

data.name: TorrentFileEntryNoLength
data.value: A file entry has no length.

data.name: TorrentFileEntryNoPath
data.value: A file entry has no path.

data.name: BencodeRootNotDictionary
data.value: The root value is not a dictionary.
data.comment: Bencode is the encoding of .torrent files and tracker replies.

data.name: BencodeTooDeep
data.value: The data is nested too deeply.

data.name: BencodeUnexpectedEnd
data.value: Unexpected end of data at offset {0}.
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeUnterminatedList
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeUnterminatedDictionary
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeKeyNotString
data.value: Dictionary key at offset {0} is not a string.
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeUnexpectedByte
data.comment: {0} = byte value in hexadecimal, {1} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeUnterminatedInteger
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeInvalidInteger
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeStringLengthNoColon
data.value: String length at offset {0} is not terminated by a colon.
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeInvalidStringLength
data.comment: {0} = byte offset.

data.name: BencodeStringTooLong
data.value: String at offset {0} declares {1} bytes but only {2} remain.
data.comment: {0} = byte offset, {1} and {2} = byte counts (any number, 1 included).

data.name: CatalogEmpty
data.comment: The client catalog is the list of emulated torrent clients (clients.json).

data.name: CatalogNoClients
data.value: The client catalog has no clients.

data.name: CatalogDuplicateName
data.value: Duplicate client name '{0}' in the catalog.
data.comment: {0} = client name.

data.name: CatalogUserEmpty
data.value: The user client catalog is empty.

data.name: CatalogUserCannotRead
data.value: Cannot read the user client catalog '{0}': {1}
data.comment: {0} = file path, {1} = error text.

data.name: CatalogEntryIncomplete
data.value: Client entry '{0}' is missing required fields.
data.comment: {0} = client name, or the CatalogEntryUnnamed text.

data.name: SessionNoRoot
data.value: The session file has no root element.
data.comment: A session file is a saved list of torrents.

data.name: UpdateUnexpectedReply
data.value: The version service returned an unexpected reply.
data.comment: Shown after "Could not reach ratiomaster.net: ".
